description: Outcome-driven proposal shaping and verified delivery for Codex, with independent validation and project-declared authority.

interface.shortDescription: Shape proposals and deliver verified, authorized changes.
interface.longDescription: Shape turns ideas into scoped proposals. Deliver implements or repairs changes through the requested authorized endpoint. Fresh report-only validators check specifications and candidates; dynamic model selection and a shared three-attempt stop rule support the main agent. Board, forge, setup, and legacy workflows remain available.
defaultPrompt: Shape this idea into a proposal with observable acceptance criteria.
Implement this change locally and verify it.
Repair the findings on this existing PR.
